title: checkout-service latency spike from payment-gateway timeouts
root_cause: A downstream payment-gateway dependency started timing out after a provider-side deploy; checkout-service had no circuit breaker so threads blocked waiting on the dependency, exhausting its own thread pool.
fix_applied: Added a circuit breaker with a 2s timeout around the payment-gateway client and enabled request hedging; paged the vendor.

title: auth-service 5xx spike from expired TLS certificate
root_cause: The internal TLS certificate used by auth-service's downstream identity provider client expired at midnight UTC; all handshake attempts failed with SSL errors.
fix_applied: Rotated the certificate via the secrets manager and added a 30-day expiry alert.

title: payment-db connection pool exhaustion after leaky deploy
root_cause: A deploy introduced a code path that opened a DB connection per request without releasing it on an early-return branch, slowly exhausting the pool until new requests queued and timed out.
fix_applied: Rolled back the deploy, then shipped a fix using a context-managed connection acquire/release; added pool-utilization alerting.

title: recommendation-service OOM from unbounded in-memory cache
root_cause: An in-process LRU cache had no size bound; under a traffic spike it grew until the process hit its memory limit and was OOM-killed repeatedly.
fix_applied: Bounded the cache size and moved to a shared Redis cache with TTL eviction.

title: checkout-service 5xx spike from cache stampede after cache-cluster restart
root_cause: A routine cache-cluster maintenance restart cleared the cache; the resulting flood of cache-miss requests overwhelmed the origin database simultaneously (thundering herd).
fix_applied: Added request coalescing and jittered TTLs; warmed the cache before maintenance windows.

title: image-upload-service disk-full from unrotated logs
root_cause: Debug logging was left on after an incident investigation and log rotation was misconfigured, filling the local disk and causing write failures.
fix_applied: Restored log rotation config, reduced log level, and added disk-utilization alerting.

title: auth-service error spike from bad config push (rate limit misconfigured)
root_cause: A config push accidentally set the auth-service rate limiter to 1 req/s per key instead of 1000, causing most legitimate traffic to be throttled.
fix_applied: Rolled back the config, added config-diff review gate for rate-limit changes.

title: checkout-service degraded from noisy-neighbor CPU saturation
root_cause: A co-located batch job on the same node pool consumed most of the shared CPU quota, throttling checkout-service pods and inflating latency.
fix_applied: Moved the batch job to a dedicated node pool and set CPU requests/limits on all workloads.
